mapper.sql: select o.order_id, o.order_no, o.order_title, o.supplier_id, o.supplier_name, o.total_amount, o.order_date, o.status, o.qc_status, o.shop_dept_id, shop_dept.dept_name as shop_dept_name, o.applicant_id, o.applicant_name, u.nick_name as applicant_nick_name, o.applicant_dept_id, applicant_dept.dept_name as applicant_dept_name, o.create_by, o.create_time, o.update_by, o.update_time, o.remark, (select coalesce(sum(d.quantity), 0) from inv_purchase_detail d where d.order_id = o.order_id) as total_quantity, (select coalesce(sum(ifnull(d.received_quantity, 0)), 0) from inv_purchase_detail d where d.order_id = o.order_id) as received_quantity, (select coalesce(sum(d.quantity - ifnull(d.received_quantity, 0)), 0) from inv_purchase_detail d where d.order_id = o.order_id) as remaining_quantity from inv_purchase_order o left join sys_dept shop_dept on shop_dept.dept_id = o.shop_dept_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = o.applicant_id left join sys_dept applicant_dept on applicant_dept.dept_id = o.applicant_dept_id
mapper.select: select order_id, order_no, order_title, supplier_id, supplier_name, total_amount, order_date, status, qc_status, shop_dept_id, applicant_id, applicant_name, applicant_dept_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from inv_purchase_order where order_id = #{orderId} for update

where o.shop_dept_id = #{shopDeptId} and o.status not in ('draft', 'cancelled')
and (o.order_no like concat('%', #{orderNo}, '%') or o.supplier_name like concat('%', #{orderNo}, '%'))
and o.supplier_name like concat('%', #{supplierName}, '%')
and exists ( select 1 from inv_purchase_detail d where d.order_id = o.order_id and > coalesce(( select sum(return_detail.quantity) from inv_purchase_return_detail return_detail inner join inv_purchase_return purchase_return on purchase_return.return_id = return_detail.return_id where purchase_return.purchase_order_id = o.order_id and purchase_return.status in ('submitted', 'returned') and return_detail.purchase_detail_id = d.detail_id ), 0) ) order by o.create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into inv_purchase_order ( order_no, order_title, supplier_id, supplier_name, total_amount, order_date, status, qc_status, shop_dept_id, applicant_id, applicant_name, applicant_dept_id, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{orderNo}, #{orderTitle}, #{supplierId}, #{supplierName}, #{totalAmount}, #{orderDate}, #{status}, #{qcStatus}, #{shopDeptId}, #{applicantId}, #{applicantName}, #{applicantDeptId}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.update: update inv_purchase_order set order_title = #{orderTitle}, supplier_id = #{supplierId}, supplier_name = #{supplierName}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, order_date = #{orderDate}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where order_id = #{orderId} and status = 'draft'
update inv_purchase_order set status = #{status}, qc_status = #{qcStatus}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where order_id = #{orderId} and status = #{expectedStatus}
